title: The Academy as a common section glued from local necessity
claim: At Union scale, the repeated business relation is the concrete carrier of the mathematical gluing relation: receivers may disagree locally, but every receiver whose exact office lacks a qualified current character derives the same provider-neutral service category; the Academy becomes a common supplier only by repeatedly winning receiver-awarded market lots.

construction.localSection: one receiver-owned office epoch, receiver-owned incumbency census, and receiver-authored necessity attestation
construction.restriction: the attestation carries only the receiver's own evidence and authority state
construction.agreement: compatible attestations agree on the Academy service interface while preserving different offices, specializations, contexts, prices, refusals, and appointments
construction.gluedSection: LocallyGluedAcademyDemand names common service need, tenders, bids, and awards without creating global incumbency or management authority

organizationalReading: LMT → BOD → EO → operating enterprises is the responsibility-and-procurement chain. Receiver → market lot → competing bids → receiver award → winning provider is the officer-supply chain. UOA recursively contracts voluntary suppliers to make its own bid feasible.
fixedPoint: When the Academy can supply a currently qualified character for every admitted exact office demand, while every receiver can still independently refuse and the verifier finds no unowned reusable executor law, the professionalization relation is closed for that corpus epoch.
failureModes: counting a central census as local agreement
counting an Academy or EO offer as receiver acceptance
preselecting the Academy in the local derivation instead of making it compete
turning a repeatedly winning provider into a central appointing authority
equating a supplied character or ephemeral model call with an officer
hiding uncontracted or refused receivers inside a total-demand claim

professionalFormationBoundary.scope: LocalOfficerSupplyNecessity and LocallyGluedAcademyDemand establish receiver-local officer-supply need and awarded providers. They do not determine whether a staffed enterprise needs further formation, requalification, shared practice, or succession. The Academy is a continuing institution of situated professional learning, examination and practice transmission, not a central personnel authority.

receiverLocalNeedReadings.evidence: A complete, current receiver-owned census of the exact office epoch lacks a qualified, recognized and inducted incumbent.
receiverLocalNeedReadings.response: Existing officer-supply derivation, neutral tender and receiver-controlled award; no forced Academy selection.

receiverLocalNeedReadings.evidence: A receiver identifies a specific judgment, skill or accountable-performance gap even with a current incumbent.
receiverLocalNeedReadings.response: Existing formation and customer-local practicum; no new vacancy, relief or automatic credential.

receiverLocalNeedReadings.evidence: An evidenced change of office, curriculum, assessment, jurisdiction or execution substrate invalidates the applicability of an earlier competence witness.
receiverLocalNeedReadings.response: Use existing baseline and formation-epoch gaps; preserve original qualifications and examine only the warranted bridge.

receiverLocalNeedReadings.evidence: Qualified participants cannot yet demonstrate a lawful joint Work handoff, independent review or nonconflicting crew performance.
receiverLocalNeedReadings.response: Use existing situated and Voidfleet group exercises; distinct masks or model sessions do not establish independent agents.

receiverLocalNeedReadings.evidence: A receiver-held continuing duty lacks a witnessed lawful handover or backup during interruption, despite an occupied office.
receiverLocalNeedReadings.response: Existing succession exercises and receiver authority; the Academy neither appoints a successor nor relieves an incumbent.

receiverLocalNeedReadings.evidence: Duty performance is blocked by unavailable source, executor, provider, rights, money or runtime, not an evidenced educational deficit.
receiverLocalNeedReadings.response: Retain original Work and route its upstream CapabilityDemand or Engineering/Operations correction; do not prescribe retraining as a substitute.

evidenceLaws: A missing, outdated or incomplete census is unknown, not proof of a vacancy or of staffing sufficiency. Only the receiver can validate its local premises and authorize a need.
Competence, lawful authority, and installed operational capacity are different claims with different assayers and recipients; qualification is not a guarantee of service delivery.

Learning requires granted participation in situated practice and independently examined demonstrations, including refusal, handoff, uncertainty and teaching-back; attendance, model choice and eloquent simulation are insufficient.

No language, sensory modality, body, disability profile or model family is a default qualification requirement: derive essential competencies and accessible modes of demonstration from the actual receiver situation.
Professional jurisdiction remains contestable and learning must admit correction from affected receivers and practitioners; Academy supply success does not make its curriculum a monopoly.
Academy learning is admitted only through its existing controlled successor doctrine, formation baseline, cohort and AcademyKnowledgeEpoch methods, not by mutating qualifications or customer Work.

counterexamplesForIndependentReceiving.expected: evaluate the actual competency, not an ungrounded default language or sensory channel

professionalFormationBoundary.statusBoundary: These are conceptual need distinctions and receiving discriminators, not new executable operation schemas, qualifications, appointments, permissions, installed abilities or accepted downstream Work. Any changed software must pass the original Requirement-to-generated-Engineering method and independent real-consumer receiving.
